digital.title: Websites, applications and business platforms
digital.promise: A digital solution should not only look good. It should simplify an action, solve a problem and support your growth.
digital.description: We design websites, applications and business platforms around your users and operational processes. Every journey is made simple, even when the underlying business rules are complex.
digital.challenge: Your teams use several disconnected files or tools, your customers encounter friction in their journey, or your activity still depends on many manual operations.
solutions: Web and mobile applications adapted to your business
B2B and B2C platforms with dedicated user areas
Connections to your existing tools, databases and APIs
benefits: A simpler experience for customers and teams
Fewer manual entries and operational errors
A solution able to evolve with your business
digital.example: Design of a vehicle rental platform covering B2C and B2B journeys, vehicle search, quotations, bookings, company quotas and approval workflows.

automation.title: Operations automation
automation.promise: Your teams should spend their time making decisions and serving customers, not repeating the same tasks.
automation.description: We identify the operations slowing down your activity and build reliable, traceable automations adapted to your business rules.
automation.challenge: Files must be prepared every week, information is copied between several tools, follow-ups are forgotten or some tasks still depend entirely on human intervention.
solutions: Automation of administrative and commercial tasks
Automatic generation of documents and reports
Automatic alerts for delays and anomalies
automation.example: Development of an algorithm connected to business datamarts to automatically consolidate monthly indicators, calculate KPIs and generate presentations used to manage the commercial network.

data.title: Data and decision support
data.promise: Your data becomes valuable when it helps you understand what is happening and make decisions faster.
data.description: We organise, clean and combine your data to turn it into readable, reliable indicators that your teams can use directly.
data.challenge: Your data is scattered, figures differ from one file to another, reports take too long to prepare or management lacks a clear view of performance.
solutions: Design of datamarts adapted to business needs
Definition of KPIs and calculation rules
benefits: Better detection of gaps and opportunities
data.example: Management of Marketing, CRM and Commercial Performance datamarts, from collecting requirements through to validating KPIs, aggregation rules and data quality.

ai.title: Applied artificial intelligence
ai.promise: Artificial intelligence becomes useful when it addresses a clearly identified decision, task or opportunity.
ai.description: We integrate AI into practical use cases: supporting teams, analysing documents, recommending actions, qualifying prospects and anticipating behaviour.
ai.challenge: You want to use AI but do not know which use case to prioritise, how to integrate it into your tools or how to control the reliability of its responses.
solutions: AI assistants and copilots adapted to your business
Recommendation engines and Next Best Action
Automatic analysis of documents, text and audio
Voice agents for reception and qualification
benefits: Teams better supported in their decisions
Practical use of large volumes of information
ai.example: Design of an AI voice agent connected to commercial documents for property developments, able to answer questions, qualify prospects and send opportunities to the CRM.

crm.title: CRM and commercial performance
crm.promise: A commercial opportunity is more likely to succeed when it reaches the right person, at the right time, with the right message.
crm.description: We structure customer data, opportunities and commercial actions to help your teams prioritise, follow up and convert more effectively.
crm.challenge: Customer information is scattered, opportunities are not properly tracked, follow-ups depend on individual files or teams do not know which prospects to prioritise.
solutions: Structuring and centralisation of customer data
Automation of campaigns and contact actions
crm.example: Design of an internal commercial opportunity management system, followed by its industrialisation to orchestrate campaigns and prioritise team actions.

architecture.title: Architecture, security and deployment
architecture.promise: A reliable solution must remain secure, maintainable and efficient long after it is launched.
architecture.description: We design the technical architecture, access rights, roles and deployment processes while taking security and future growth into account from the start.
architecture.challenge: Your solution must support several user profiles, protect sensitive information, evolve over time or be deployed without interrupting operations.
benefits: Access rights adapted to each user
A technical foundation ready to evolve
architecture.example: Deployment of Next.js and NestJS platforms using PostgreSQL, JWT authentication, role management, Docker, Traefik and automated GitHub Actions workflows.

analytics.title: Analytics, tracking and digital performance analysis
analytics.promise: You should not invest in visibility without knowing what truly attracts, engages and converts your visitors.
analytics.description: We implement reliable tracking of your digital journeys to connect visitors, campaigns, prospects and sales within a single view.
analytics.challenge: You know your overall traffic but cannot clearly identify which campaigns, pages or actions generate forms, baskets, sales or revenue.
solutions: Audit of your website and traffic sources
Definition of KPIs and creation of a tracking plan
Installation and configuration of Google Tag Manager
Tracking of clicks, forms, baskets and transactions
Connection of CRM, advertising and e-commerce data
Data centralisation in BigQuery when appropriate
Creation of custom Looker Studio dashboards
benefits: A clear understanding of the conversion funnel
More accurate measurement of return on investment
Marketing decisions based on real indicators
analytics.example: Automation of the collection and transformation of digital marketing data to supply decision-making dashboards used to manage commercial performance.

leadGeneration.title: Lead generation and closing support
leadGeneration.promise: Attracting more visitors is not enough. You need a journey capable of turning them into opportunities and then into customers.
leadGeneration.description: We connect acquisition, content, forms, qualification, CRM and follow-ups to build a clearer and more efficient commercial funnel.
leadGeneration.challenge: Your company receives too few qualified enquiries, loses prospects after the first interaction or lacks a clear method for following opportunities through to closing.
solutions: Connection of leads to the CRM
Monitoring of the sales funnel and conversion rates
Support in structuring closing stages and sales arguments
benefits: Better visibility over the commercial pipeline
leadGeneration.example: Implementation of a complete qualified-lead generation process: identifying prospects through social media and artificial intelligence, qualification by our commercial teams, then delivery to the company of genuinely interested contacts ready to be converted.

marketingStrategy.title: Marketing strategy, visibility and online image
marketingStrategy.promise: Before communicating more, you need to understand what your market expects, what your competitors offer and what makes your company credible.
marketingStrategy.description: We analyse your environment, positioning and customer journeys to build a coherent, measurable marketing strategy adapted to your resources.
marketingStrategy.challenge: Your company lacks visibility, its message remains unclear, its marketing actions are inconsistent or it does not know how to differentiate itself from competitors.
solutions: Market research and analysis of customer expectations
Analysis of positioning and online image
Clarification of target audiences and messages
Definition of channels and content plans
Improvement of discovery and conversion journeys
benefits: A more coherent and credible image
A better understanding of the market
marketingStrategy.example: Customer knowledge, segmentation, geomarketing and performance analyses used to guide commercial and marketing decisions.

hero.title: We turn today’s obstacles into tomorrow’s opportunities.

story.title: Axplify was born from a simple observation.

paragraphs.first: Business ambitions evolve quickly, but tools, processes and working habits do not always move at the same pace.
paragraphs.second: Tasks that should take minutes may involve several people. Information moves between files, messages and disconnected systems. Data exists, but it is often too scattered to support confident decisions.
paragraphs.third: Axplify Services was created to close this gap. Our role is to understand what is truly holding an organisation back and turn that reality into digital solutions that are simple to use, aligned with its priorities and ready to evolve.

story.statement: We do not create technology to add complexity. We design it to make ambition more accessible.

mission.title: Make digital transformation practical, understandable and useful.
mission.description: We place business needs before tools so that every technology decision serves a clearly identified objective.

understand.title: Listen to the need in its real context

points.process: Reconstruct the main stages of the current process.

points.approval: Approve the problem, scope and priorities.
points.adjustments: Correct misunderstandings or complete missing information.
points.decision: Obtain clear approval before the next stage.

delivery.title: Build progressively without losing direction
delivery.description: Delivery is divided into coherent and testable increments. Every advance remains connected to the approved need and produces a visible result.

points.reviews: Present progress regularly and collect feedback.
points.quality: Control security, access, data and overall quality.

launch.title: Put the solution into service and help it evolve
launch.description: We prepare the launch, user adoption and future improvements based on real usage and measured results.

points.deployment: Prepare deployment, data and user access.
points.evolution: Prioritise improvements based on real feedback.
